title: AnimoFlow community model registry
description: Schema for community/models.json. Each entry describes one community-built model container implementing the HTTP contract in community/CONTRACT.md.

name.description: Registry-unique identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens only. Must match the `name` in the container's MODELS.yaml.

description.description: One or two sentences: what the model does and what it needs.

repo_url.description: Source repository of the container wrapper (must be https).

image.description: Pullable container image reference, e.g. ghcr.io/you/yourmodel-animoflow:0.1.0.

license.description: License of the container + model (SPDX identifier where possible, e.g. MIT, BSD-3-Clause, or 'research-only').

maintainer.description: Who to contact, e.g. 'Name <email>' or a GitHub handle.

contract_version.description: HTTP contract version the container implements (community/CONTRACT.md).

gpu_required.description: True if CPU inference is impractical.

paper_url.description: Optional link to the paper (must be https).
